scope: Bounded complete exact rational sparse affine solution families and shared dense/sparse gauss_jordan_solve; no whole-workstream or compatibility-profile certification.

implemented.mathematics: All consistent solutions of A*X=B are represented by X=P+N*T. All RHS columns share one sparse augmented row-reduction witness; P is n by k, N is n by nullity, T is nullity by k.
implemented.independent_verifier: Dependency-separated proof kernel replays invertible exact row operations, binds both original matrices, verifies coefficient rank/free-column complement, A*P=B, A*N=0, zero particular free coordinates and identity kernel free coordinates. Inconsistency requires a genuine RHS pivot in the verified augmented RREF.
implemented.native: Source-bound untrusted candidates and private accepted wrappers expose rational particular/kernel parts, receipt, rank, consistency and free columns. Single-ledger APIs cover admission through publication; optional separate phase meters do not themselves establish a protected runtime reservation.
implemented.symbolic_output: Native construction of row-major plain tau parameters and the exact family stays in the same Work ledger with parameter, term and aggregate stored-output preflight limits.
implemented.public: Dense/sparse mutable/immutable gauss_jordan_solve share the checked sparse engine across all RHS columns. Solution and parameter outputs retain the coefficient class. Original storage/interface/source snapshots and canonical parameter-cache ownership are checked; result construction uses captured storage descriptors.
implemented.expanded_scope: The dense matrix method no longer has the old 128-dimension/per-RHS repeated-elimination restriction. Existing dense storage and new sparse/augmented/output bounds still apply. The separate linsolve 128-dimension lane is unchanged.

limits.note: Independent checker and caller meters impose additional cumulative limits. Limits are preflight/terminal refusals, not promises that every shape below them completes.

public_boundaries: Exact rational built-in inputs only; symbolic/approximate coefficients and custom matrix subclasses are refused.
freevar must be a bool; zero RHS columns with unknowns remain an explicit public refusal, although the native family API represents the empty matrix equation.
Dense input/final output retain the dense storage bound; sparse computation does not materialize an implicit dense matrix.
Canonical tau cache ownership and original interfaces are required; no Python scalar-arithmetic or constructor fallback.
LUsolve remains the unique-solution interface and retains RHS class; gauss_jordan_solve retains coefficient class.
